title: Migration contract v1 (M2-M6; synthetic source packages only, real exports blocked on M-S1)

PackageRef.description: Opaque reference of one staged source package (tenant from context, never from input).

ProfileRef.description: Opaque reference of one source profile version.

ItemRef.description: Opaque reference of one staff review item.

PatientRef.description: Opaque patient reference owned by workstream S.

ReasonCode.description: Server-checked reason enumeration value; never free text.

MinorUnits.description: Signed integer minor units (SHARED-CONTRACTS Money). Never a float.

Money.description: SHARED-CONTRACTS Money: explicit currency and integer minor units. Never a float.

SourceSystem.description: Source system label. Only synthetic (`syn-`) systems are accepted until M-S1 closes.

SourceFormat.description: Versioned source adapter format. Only the fabricated synthetic legacy format is registered.

SourcePackage.description: A synthetic source package: CSV tables (header row first) and a manifest of declared counts and SHA-256 digests of each table text.

Authorisation.description: The practice's evidenced export authorisation (synthetic reference until M-S1 closes).

proposal.description: Adapter proposal with confidence and provenance; never applied without a decision.

confirmationToken.description: S6 merge confirmation token (issued by S6 duplicate review); M issues none of its own.

IdentityMergeResult.description: The S6 mergePatients result, returned verbatim.

report.description: Per-entity declared/staged/applied/excluded/blocked counts, per-guarantor Money comparison, unapplied credit, exceptions by category, blocking exceptions with required action, not-imported count.

acknowledgedExclusions.description: H2 M-7: the financial reviewer acknowledges each excluded balance of the report by its staged reference (subjectRef staged:<ref> of an excluded_balance exception).

ExportRef.description: Opaque reference of one practice export (tenant from context).

purpose.description: Why the export is taken (recorded with the export; never free text).

token.description: Short-lived delivery token; never stored or logged.

ArchiveRef.description: Opaque reference of one archive package version.

content.description: The source row as received (read-only historical record; never a live fact).

Placeholder.description: A placeholder name or contact (no real contact data is stored until M-S3 names the operator).

DowntimeWindowRef.description: Opaque reference of one downtime window (tenant from context).

DowntimeEntryRef.description: Opaque reference of one downtime log entry.

DowntimeLocationRef.description: Membership location reference (the same reference space as location policy).

DowntimeAppliedCommand.description: The committed owning command that applied the entry: its operation id, the resource it produced or changed, and its request correlation id.

payload.description: Structured transcription of the paper record as named fields (synthetic only); stored as logged, never applied. Field names are unique.

paperRef.description: Reference of the paper sheet or form the entry was transcribed from.

ListScope.description: OR-01 scope: tenant-wide, the caller's assigned locations, or an explicit location set (locationRefs present for the last two).

ReviewerAssignmentRef.description: Opaque reference of one migration reviewer assignment (tenant from context).

ReviewerAssignmentState.description: Derived: revoked once the assignment was ended; an ended assignment is kept, never deleted.

ListEnvelope.description: OR-01 list envelope, shared by every list and worklist response.

asOf.description: Server instant the list was read.

appliedFilters.description: Normalized filters, including the defaults the server applied.
